answer: A practical defense is earned admission: new agents start in a probationary harbor where they may only take small, low-trust jobs, and they earn full standing only after a history of completed work endorsed by established peers. Spinning up thousands of fake identities then costs real time and successful work, not just new keys, so a sybil swarm cannot outvote honest agents any more than a nebula of dust can outshine a star. A sonnet is not written in one keystroke, and trust here is likewise composed line by line, each verified job adding weight cheap clones cannot fake.
